title: Compliance Officer
description:
Flow Traders is looking for a Compliance Officer to join our Compliance team in New York. The ideal candidate is self-motivated with a strong analytical and problem-solving mentality. This is a unique opportunity to join a leading proprietary trading firm with an entrepreneurial and innovative culture at the heart of its business. We value quick-witted, creative minds and challenge them to make full use of their capacities.

This Compliance Officer will play a central role in the Know Your Customer (“KYC”) / Anti-Money Laundering (“AML”) program as well as the firm's employee compliance program. Responsibilities span reviewing and onboarding institutional counterparties, investigating alerts across a wide range of risk areas including personal trading, sanctions and negative news, electronic communications, and exchange registrations, and supporting the full lifecycle of employee compliance obligations. This position offers broad exposure across the compliance function, close collaboration with the Chief Compliance Officer (“CCO”), and the opportunity to help shape and strengthen policies and procedures as the firm grows.

What you will do

- Collect, review, and document new institutional counterparty onboardings and periodic updates

- Review and investigate compliance alerts across a broad range of areas including personal trading, sanctions/negative news, electronic communications, and exchange registrations, among others — documenting findings in clear, well-supported case notes

- Manage employee access to third-party trading, clearing, and compliance platforms

- Support the broader employee compliance program, including in the areas of employee onboardings/terminations, personal trading, outside business activities, gifts and entertainment, political contributions, exchange registrations, social media, electronic communications, and continuing education

- Assist with the implementation and dissemination of Written Supervisory Procedures, identifying opportunities to strengthen the compliance program and promoting a culture of compliance across the organization

- Support the CCO with day-to-day functions and compliance projects, including shared ownership of global Compliance initiatives

What you need to succeed

- At least three years of relevant experience in AML/KYC and/or broker-dealer compliance strongly preferred

- Undergraduate degree in Finance, Economics, or Business

- Mature, professional, and of unquestionable integrity, exercising excellent judgment when handling sensitive information

- Strong writing skills, with the ability to translate facts and analysis into clear, well-organized case notes and alert documentation

- Strong organizational skills with high attention to detail

- Process-based approach to problem-solving, with the ability to develop informed and concrete proposals

- Motivated self-starter who can manage competing priorities and thrive in a fast-paced environment

- Familiarity with third-party vendors such as World-Check One, ACA ComplianceAlpha, Salesforce, Smarsh, Bloomberg Vault, and Microsoft Purview, a plus

- Proficiency in Python and/or SQL, a plus

title: Data Center Engineer
description:
Flow Traders is looking for an experienced Datacenter Engineer to own and support the physical infrastructure across our European colocation estate, including latency-sensitive trading sites, back-office datacenters, and microwave/wireless locations. You will be responsible for the full physical infrastructure lifecycle, from new deployments and hardware refreshes to troubleshooting, capacity planning, documentation, and decommissioning. This is a highly hands-on role requiring regular travel across Europe and close collaboration with Network, Systems, Trading Infrastructure, carriers, and colocation providers.

Core Responsibilities

- Rack, cable, power, commission, troubleshoot, and decommission servers, storage, and network equipment.

- Deliver new datacenter deployments, hardware refreshes, site expansions, and connectivity projects.

- Act as the on-site escalation point for hardware, cabling, power, thermal, optics, and physical network incidents.

- Monitor and forecast rack space, power, cooling, and cross-connect capacity across sites.

- Manage cross-connects, remote hands, site access, carriers, colocation providers, and specialist contractors.

- Maintain accurate hardware, spares, cabling, rack elevation, and site documentation.

- Coordinate hardware shipping, RMAs, receiving, and asset disposal across European locations.

- Support microwave and wireless locations and supervise specialist contractors where required.

- Participate in change management, incident response, postmortems, and an out-of-hours on-call rota.

- Standardize infrastructure practices and automate repetitive operational tasks where possible.

Core Skills & Requirements

- 5+ years of hands-on datacenter experience in a business-critical production environment; trading or other latency-sensitive experience is preferred.

- Strong server hardware knowledge, including rack installation, PDUs, firmware/BIOS, out-of-band management, and component-level troubleshooting.

- Strong structured cabling knowledge across copper, DAC/Twinax, and SM/MM fibre, including optical testing.

- Good understanding of colocation power, cooling, redundancy, and environmental monitoring.

- Basic troubleshooting and configuration experience with Cisco/Arista networking and Linux/Debian systems.

- Experience managing colocation providers, carriers, contractors, cross-connects, and remote hands.

- Strong project delivery, documentation, incident management, and stakeholder communication skills.

- Willingness to travel frequently across Europe and participate in on-call support.

- Valid driving licence and unrestricted ability to travel to and work at provider sites across the EU.

title: Infrastructure Platform Engineer
description:
About the role

Infrastructure Platform Engineer runs the trading system infrastructure Flow Traders trades on: the global Linux fleet — trading servers, workstations and VDIs — and the multi-cloud and distributed-systems estate that sits alongside it. We also build and run the self-service infrastructure platform the rest of Technology depends on.

We are hiring two engineers into this team. This is a hands-on engineering role: most of your time goes on writing Terraform, building CI workflows and guardrails, automating toil out of the Linux fleet, and operating what you build. A lot of the shared tooling does not exist yet, and building it is the job rather than a side effect of it. The environment is trading-critical and runs across both on-premise infrastructure and public cloud, and you will work on both sides of that line rather than specialising in one.

To be clear about the shape of the seat: this is build-and-operate rather than architecture, strategy or management. There is architecture in it, but the bulk of the work is hands-on and there are no direct reports. A solid Linux foundation is essential across the whole role — it underpins both sides of the estate, and the cloud, container and Kubernetes work rests on it just as much as the on-premise fleet does.

What you will do

- Write, debug and publish reusable Terraform modules that other engineers consume, covering both the Linux fleet and the cloud estate.

- Design and own CI/CD workflows and guardrails in GitHub Actions — the policy checks, tests and approval gates that let engineers across Technology self-serve infrastructure safely.

- Build and operate Kubernetes on both sides of the estate — managed clusters in cloud and k3s on-premise — along with the distributed systems running on it, particularly Kafka.

- Provision and operate GCP, AWS and Alibaba Cloud resources through Infrastructure as Code.

- Operate and automate the Linux estate: Foreman provisioning across VMs and bare metal, Puppet for host configuration, Ansible/AWX for application deployment, plus patching and lifecycle.

- Build automation and internal tooling in Python or Go, with test-driven development as a normal working habit.

- Take a share of the global 24/7 on-call rotation, and cross-skill deliberately between the Linux and cloud sides of the estate.

What you will need to succeed

- Strong Terraform experience, including writing, debugging and producing reusable modules for others to consume.

- CI/CD experience, ideally GitHub Actions — and the guardrails, not only the pipelines. We want to hear about the gates and policy checks you built and why each one exists. Equivalent GitLab CI or Jenkins experience is fine.

- Solid Kubernetes in production across workloads, CNI, Helm and Argo. Self-managed or bare-metal clusters are a strong plus, as is contributing to or authoring operators.

- Hands-on experience provisioning and operating GCP or AWS through Infrastructure as Code, with an appetite to go deeper.

- Strong Linux fundamentals — you can debug a production host without a runbook: processes, networking, storage, systemd, logs, kernel versus user space.

- Proficiency in Python or Go, with demonstrable experience of test-driven development.

- Direct experience of production on-call and incident response, and a considered view on what makes a rotation sustainable.

- Typically 5+ years in infrastructure, platform or systems engineering. Fluent written and spoken English. Based in the Amsterdam area or willing to relocate — this role is on-site and is not remote.

Nice to have

- A genuine cross-domain background — both Linux/systems and cloud/platform, rather than one of them plus a passing acquaintance with the other.

- GCP specifically, as our primary cloud.

- Kafka in production. Real Kafka depth would be a significant win for us.

- Our fleet tooling: Puppet for host configuration management at scale, Ansible and AWX, and Foreman.

- Bare-metal and datacenter infrastructure — provisioning, hardware lifecycle, virtualization (VMware, Proxmox) — and networking depth across routing, load balancing, BGP and multicast.

- Financial services, trading, or another high-availability, latency-sensitive environment. Dutch is useful but not required.

description:

The impact of crypto on trading has been both profound and multifaceted and we expect it to reshape traditional financial markets with unprecedented speed. Are you interested in joining this unique Talent Pool? We are always searching for passionate individuals with an interest in crypto. If you are intrigued by or already involved in the digital asset space, we want to hear from you!
